Resolves #20589

The news section gets a seventh tab, `#/news/videos`, listing the films in `videos.json`, newest first. Each item stays a facade, a lazily loaded `i.ytimg.com` preview with a play button, until a visitor clicks it. Only the active item renders the `youtube-nocookie.com` player, so at most one film plays. The search field filters the store by title and highlights the matches. A film the search hides stops, and clearing the search brings back its facade, not a restarted player.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium against the dev server, YouTube hosts stubbed; CI runs the same spec off-socket) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4). Residual: neomjs.com shows the tab only after the 13.4 publish, see Post-Merge Validation.

Change class: capability (`feat`). agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline PR jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `VideosNL.spec.mjs` › facades until a click… checks 12 items, newest first, with title, date and product. The previews load lazily: fewer than 12 load before scrolling. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same test. No request reaches a `youtube.com`, `youtube-nocookie.com`, `googlevideo.com` or `google.com` host before a click. One click gives one nocookie `iframe`; a second click leaves one, on the second film. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the same test, where `grid` leaves 2 items with highlighted matches; unit `List.spec.mjs` › the search highlights its matches and stops a film it hides. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the page title comes from the `/news/videos` row; `VideosNL.spec.mjs` › `<theme>`: the cards take the theme's colours, in both themes. Screenshots below. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: unit `List.spec.mjs` › the shipped videos.json loads newest first, every entry complete. The file is the twelve-film catalog from #20589 (comment 6719248900), checked deep-equal by script; trimming it is a data-only edit. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The previews use native `loading="lazy"` rather than copying the Medium list's IntersectionObserver wiring. `loading` comes before `src` because the DOM renderer applies attributes in key order; a unit test pins that order.
- The search sets a `like` filter on the store's `name`, so `list.Base` re-renders, instead of Medium's per-item `display: none`.
- The iframe carries `referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"`, as YouTube's own embed code does.
- `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` now checks for `#/news/blog` instead of any `#/news` route. The check guards the CI exclusion of `blog.json`, which the news/blog view alone reads. On `#/news/videos` the App Worker holds only the Videos store: no `BlogNeo` store and no blog view, measured through the Neural Link. So the exclusion still holds, and the narrowed check still catches the blog route.

Run locally at a45ba8da14 with `NEO_NL_PORT=18081`, an isolated bridge:

- Three mutations, each red at the named assertion and then reverted:
  - `src` before `loading` fails unit "a facade renders the lazy preview…".
  - Dropping the filter reset fails unit "…stops a film it hides".
  - `loading: 'eager'` fails e2e "the previews below the fold wait", with 12 of 12 loaded.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket `#20589` and its intake/curation comments (`6719069352`, `6719248900`), changed-file list (`18` files), `dev` source of `apps/portal/view/news/TabContainer.mjs`, `TabContainerController.mjs`, `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`, `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs`, and `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs`, sibling precedent in `apps/portal/view/news/medium/{Container,List}.mjs` and `apps/portal/{model,store}/BlogMedium.mjs`, plus `src/list/Base.mjs`, `src/Neo.mjs`, and `core-idiom-audit.md`.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `Portal.model.Video` (`extends Neo.data.Model`) and `Portal.store.Videos` (`extends Neo.data.Store`, `autoLoad: true`, `keyProperty: 'id'`, `id` DESC sorter, `videos.json` URL) bound to `Portal.view.news.videos.List` inside `Portal.view.news.videos.Container`. Each item renders a lazy-thumbnail facade (`i.ytimg.com` or `record.thumbnail` override) with no `youtube.com` / `youtube-nocookie.com` / `googlevideo.com` requests before click, and a single reactive `activeId_` swaps at most one item to a `youtube-nocookie.com` `iframe` while title search clears a hidden active film. Must not hardcode tab indexes in `TabContainerController` (`activateRoute('/news/videos')`), must keep styles in SCSS, and must register `portal/VideosNL.spec.mjs` in `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS`.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Improves on expected shape. Instead of copying `medium/List.mjs`'s `150ms` + 10-retry `IntersectionObserver` loop and imperative `item.style.display = 'none'` filter, `Portal.store.Videos` declares `filters: [{operator: 'like', property: 'name', value: null}]`, `List#createNameNodes` escapes regex metacharacters via `StringUtil.escapeRegExp` and emits structured VDOM nodes, and `List#createItemContent` places `loading: 'lazy'` before `src` on `<img class="portal-videos-thumbnail">` inside a semantic `<button type="button" class="portal-videos-facade">`.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with `verify-before-assert` and `friction->gold`: the `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` reach guard for `blog.json` (`/#/news/` -> `/#/news\/blog/`) was narrowed only after verifying via Neural Link that `#/news/videos` instantiates `Portal.store.Videos` without loading `Portal.store.BlogNeo` or `blog.json`, and `VideosNL.spec.mjs` joins `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS` so the new e2e spec runs off-socket in `e2e-engine` on every PR.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: In Neo VDOM lists (`Neo.list.Base`), native `<img loading="lazy">` requires the `loading` key to precede `src` in the VDOM object literal because `DomAccess` applies attributes in `Object.keys` iteration order; setting `src` before `loading` starts the network fetch eagerly before the browser sees `loading="lazy"`.
